chunks: The two went on till they came to a boy, whom he killed. Moses exclaimed: 'You have killed an innocent soul who had taken no life. You have done a most abominable thing!'
ai.seo_question: Why did Al-Khidr kill the young boy in Surah Al-Kahf?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Al-Kahf, Prophet Moses (AS) questions Al-Khidr’s slaying of a young boy, perceiving it as an inexplicable act of killing an innocent soul. This encounter illustrates the fundamental Shia and Sunni scholarly distinction between *zahir* (the apparent, limited human perspective) and *batin* (the hidden, divine wisdom), where a seemingly unjust act serves a greater, unseen purpose ordained by Allah.
